claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows chipped paint on the machine head.
Photo 1 plate reads Singer, not a Japanese make.
No motor appears in the treadle photos; running condition cannot be checked remotely.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are visible in Photos 0-3.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history is not visible in any photo.

risks.risk: The machine does not sew or turn over.
risks.proof: Video of the balance wheel turned by hand with the needle moving, or the treadle pedaled.

risks.risk: The belt and internal mechanics are worn or broken.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the belt and underside mechanism, or a running video.

risks.risk: Accessories and the original manual are missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing bobbins, needles, and the manual together.

risks.risk: The age or year of manufacture is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up of the serial number plate or date stamp.

risks.risk: The claimed motor may not exist or may not work.
risks.proof: Photo of the motor and video of it running smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a treadle machine with no motor.

proof_requests: Video of the machine turning over and sewing.
Close-up of the belt and underside mechanics.
Photo of all accessories and the original manual.
Close-up of the serial number or manufacture date.
Photo and video of the claimed motor running.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Singer treadle sewing machine, so a worst-case floor price can be set even though the seller's condition and accessory claims are unproven.
